# Jev Trade

> Jev Trade is a Jev trading bot with browser-local execution on Hyperliquid.

Jev reads price-feed features on every trading tick and answers buy, sell, or hold. The browser applies the answer through local paper execution or direct wallet-authorized real orders. BTC, ETH, SOL, DOGE, and BNB are markets on one connected owner's account, not five server-held wallets.

Bun supplies only address-free Jev inference at /decide and process health at /health. A separate Next app serves the dashboard. Brave Wallet connection, ephemeral agent signing, account reads, public feeds, finite runs, orders, and fills stay in the browser and communicate directly with Hyperliquid. There is no server trading executor, visitor Worker, operator listener, or SSE session gateway.

Only explicit On starts a finite run. Wallet connection and authorization do not start trading. Reload does not resume it. Stop attempts exact-owned order cleanup; it does not liquidate positions or revoke venue authorization. The browser must remain awake, and orders can outlive a closed tab.

Jev is TypeSafe's trading model. OpenRouter is the default Jev provider; TypeSafe and Vercel AI Gateway are also supported. Jev makes the decision; hold is a valid answer rather than a skipped tick.

The real-trading browser path is implemented. This cutover does not establish a completed Brave Wallet approval, live fill, or verified cleanup after interruption. Those require explicit wallet testing. Paper results are simulated, not wallet balances or proof of real fills.
